d.seg: व्हाट्सएप में आओगे वीडियो कॉल चाहिए
d.tr: Will you come on WhatsApp, I need a video call
d.ctx: The user was talking about their location and profession. The user then asked the expert to join a video call on WhatsApp.
d.j: The user is proposing to move the conversation to a named external app (WhatsApp) for a video call.
